products.title: Chevron Whisper Ring
products.descriptionHtml:
A band that comes to a soft point. This ring is shaped as a double V, with two fine pave lines of small round clear cubic zirconia running along the band and meeting at the chevron. The form is cut to nest against a plain band or sit under a solitaire without crowding it. Made in a fixed US size 7, it is an easy piece to stack or wear alone.

STYLING TIP: Layer it with a plain gold band so the chevron point nests neatly against it.

Details

  • Size: US 7, fixed size, inner diameter approximately 17.3mm
  • Weight: 2g
  • Profile: Double V chevron band
  • Stone: Two fine pave lines of small round clear cubic zirconia
  • Wear: Shaped to nest against a plain band or a solitaire
  • Band height: Approximately 9.5mm at the chevron
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Pearl Ribbon Ring
products.descriptionHtml:
A bow, tied once and kept. The front of this ring is formed from two flat gold loops channel set along their length with rectangular baguette clear cubic zirconia, tied at a polished gold knot, with a round white freshwater pearl of about 10mm resting at one side. The shank behind is a slim plain gold band. Made in a fixed US size 7, it suits an engagement lunch or a festive evening.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with bare fingers and soft pink nails so the bow reads clearly.

Details

  • Size: US 7, fixed size, not adjustable
  • Front: Bow formed from two flat gold loops tied at a polished knot
  • Stone: Rectangular baguette clear cubic zirconia, channel set along each loop
  • Pearl: Round white freshwater pearl, approximately 10mm
  • Band: Slim plain gold shank
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

products.title: Whisper Pavé Band
products.descriptionHtml:
Bright at the centre, delicate underneath. This ring holds a round brilliant clear cubic zirconia of about 8mm in four claws at the heart of a cushion shaped pave halo of about 12mm square, with pave clear cubic zirconia running down both shoulders. A fine open gallery sits beneath the setting so light passes through from below. Made in a fixed size of about 17mm inside, between US 6 and 7, it suits a proposal or a big evening out.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with a fine silver tone band beside it for a quiet everyday stack.

Details

  • Size: Inner diameter approximately 17mm, between US 6 and 7
  • Stone: Round brilliant clear cubic zirconia, approximately 8mm, four claw set
  • Halo: Cushion shaped pave halo, approximately 12mm square
  • Band: Pave set clear cubic zirconia down both shoulders
  • Gallery: Fine open gallery beneath the setting
  • Plating: PVD rhodium coating, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

products.title: Vintage Halo Ring
products.descriptionHtml:
An old idea, tied into a knot. An oval clear cubic zirconia of about 8mm by 6mm sits inside a pave halo, and the shank twists into a knot just beneath the setting with pave running along the twist. The metal is PVD rhodium coated, which suits the vintage shape of the ring. Made in US size 6, about 16.5mm inside, it wears well alone or beside a plain band.

STYLING TIP: Layer it with a slim silver tone band so the knot detail stays visible.

Details
